parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the network instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table of the network instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

*   **VPC**: VPC
*   **VBR**: VBR
*   **CCN**: Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance

parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the route that you want to query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn describe-published-route-entries --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jm0000 --child-instance-id vpc-bp18sth14qii3pnv0000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --child-instance-route-table-id vtb-bp174d1gje79u1g40000 --destination-cidr-block 172.16.0.0/16 --region cn-hangzhou
